# EduLog v2.0.0-alpha.7

This prerelease improves lesson reporting, authentication, email, and company history synchronization. It also fixes scoped occurrence access and prepares Docker image validation in CI.

## Highlights

- Record makeup progress for a previous lesson and new progress for one or more courses in a single class report. Shared attendance and comments remain on the report.
- Correct a report to the occurrence where teaching happened while preserving the report ID, versions, collaboration history, attendance, comments, and source sync identity.
- Fix class calendar authorization when the request is scoped by session IDs, including teachers with classroom-scoped permissions.
- Route OAuth through the EduLog API so the browser can use the public EduLog origin while Supabase Gateway stays private.
- Isolate password and refresh-token exchanges per request.
- Refresh bilingual transactional email subjects and templates, sender display-name configuration, and callback logging.
- Keep company history sync bound to the confirmed report and lesson entry after occurrence correction.
- Link the About page to EduLog GitHub Packages and its image instructions.

## Security and reliability

- Upgrade the API IP address parsing dependency and cover additional reserved IPv6 ranges.
- Patch API HTTP client security advisories.
- Add Docker image health, proxy, runtime configuration, authentication boundary, and Presidio language smoke checks to CI.

## Database upgrade

Use matching frontend, API, and Presidio images tagged `2.0.0-alpha.7`. Alpha images do not update stable aliases.

Back up the database, then apply every unapplied migration in filename order through `1000171_extension_primary_lesson_sync.sql` before deploying the matching API and extension.

- `1000169_multi_lesson_report_entries.sql` adds per-enrollment lesson entries and backfills existing single-lesson reports while preserving their report IDs, versions, and timestamps. Older clients continue to use the primary lesson projection.
- `1000170_report_occurrence_correction.sql` adds the authenticated atomic report-correction operation.
- `1000171_extension_primary_lesson_sync.sql` binds company history synchronization to an exact report and lesson entry.

Multi-lesson progress is stored in the database. Keep a database backup before upgrade; reverting to code that does not understand lesson entries can hide additional progress.

## Verification

The merged develop commit passed application, server, database migration, security, CodeQL, API contract, SonarCloud, and Docker image checks. The local Docker smoke also passed for frontend, API, authentication boundaries, and Presidio language selection.

No pre-production environment was available for this prerelease. OAuth provider round-trips, live refresh-token behavior, and delivery of the configured email templates still need verification before production deployment. Email delivery also depends on correctly aligned sender-domain SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records and the SMTP provider reputation.

This alpha release does not deploy or migrate the existing production environment.
